posts.zh:
dsh-agent-team-gui 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。持久化多模型 Agent 小队，可在普通发送中协作：逐成员配置主用与回退的模型/工具策略，支持按项目设默认，运行中心展示计划、重试与厂商上报的 token 用量。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4af28386664ef1bd7d59.html
posts.en:
dsh-agent-team-gui is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Persistent multi-model agent squads that collaborate on ordinary sends, with per-agent primary and fallback model/tool policies, per-project defaults, and a run centre showing plans, retries, and provider-reported token usage.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4af28386664ef1bd7d59.html
